mapper.select: SELECT rating, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ai_response_feedback WHERE created_at >= #{cutoff} GROUP BY rating
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ai_human_handoffs WHERE created_at >= #{cutoff} GROUP BY status

SELECT LOWER(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(emotion, ''), 'unknown'), 'CustomerEmotion.', '')) AS emotion, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ai_human_handoffs WHERE created_at >= #{cutoff} GROUP BY LOWER(REPLACE(COALESCE(NULLIF(emotion, ''), 'unknown'), 'CustomerEmotion.', ''))
SELECT CAST(created_at AS DATE) AS stat_date, COUNT(*) AS count FROM ai_messages WHERE sender_type = 'user' AND created_at >= #{cutoff} GROUP BY CAST(created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY stat_date
